# Native Android v3 regression fixture

These files were copied unchanged from the real Android instrumentation test on
`emulator-5580`, generated by `actualAndroidEncoderAndMcapWriterExportCrossClockFixture`.
The MCAP contains three synthetic JPEG images, depth rasters and camera poses.
The first three timestamp values reproduce the observed Pixel v2 failure;
later increments and all sensor payloads are synthetic. No household footage or
physical depth measurement is included.

Unlike the frozen v2 fixture, CPU image, Android camera and Frame timestamps all
differ. API acquisition association and source-specific clock fields survive the
native Kotlin writer and Python reader. The data uses the same asymmetric
32×16 luma quadrants and 8×4 depth pattern documented in the
[v2 fixture](../android_geometry_v2/README.md). Each depth raster differs despite
sharing one native depth timestamp.

`provenance.json` records generated-file hashes and producer source/APK hashes.
The historical v2 fixture is preserved unchanged. Run:

```sh
.venv-stera/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_capture_geometry_v3.py -v
```

This covers encoder/serialization behavior, not physical acquisition or metric
accuracy. The actual Pixel must be tested separately.
